title: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure not accepted by the UE

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure not accepted by the UE
entities.description: Procedure executed by the UE when it rejects a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message from the network. The UE creates and sends a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT message with appropriate 5GSM cause.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to modify an existing PDU session. Contains PTI, Authorized QoS rules IE, Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE, and other IEs.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to reject a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND. Contains 5GSM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: IE included in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT to indicate the reason for rejection. Common values: #44 semantic error in packet filters, #45 syntactical error in packet filters, #83 semantic error in QoS operation, #84 syntactical error in QoS operation, #26 insufficient resources.

entities.name: Authorized QoS rules
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND containing QoS rule operations (create, modify, delete) and associated parameters like DQR bit, packet filters, precedence.

entities.name: Authorized QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND containing QoS flow description operations (create, modify, delete) and parameters like QFI, GBR parameters.

entities.name: T3581
entities.description: Timer stopped by the UE if the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND contains the PTI value allocated in the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: T3591
entities.description: Timer stopped by the SMF upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT in state PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING
entities.description: SMF state when a PDU session modification procedure is ongoing. SMF leaves this state upon receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ACTIVE
entities.description: SMF state entered after aborting the PDU session modification procedure upon receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT.

entities.name: Semantic error in QoS operation
entities.description: Condition triggering rejection with 5GSM cause #83. Includes cases like DQR bit mismatch, duplicate precedence, invalid rule operations on default QoS rule.

entities.name: Syntactical error in QoS operation
entities.description: Condition triggering rejection with 5GSM cause #84. Includes empty packet filter list when not allowed, invalid packet filter counts, missing mandatory GBR parameters.

entities.name: Semantic error in packet filter(s)
entities.description: Condition triggering rejection with 5GSM cause #44. Occurs when packet filter components conflict making the filter ineffective.

entities.name: Syntactical error in packet filter(s)
entities.description: Condition triggering rejection with 5GSM cause #45. Includes duplicate packet filter identifiers, reserved values in packet filter components.

entities.name: UE stops timer T3581
entities.description: Behavior where the UE stops timer T3581 if the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND contains the PTI value from UE-requested procedure.

entities.name: SMF stops timer T3591
entities.description: Behavior where the SMF stops timer T3591 upon receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state.

relations.description: The procedure includes creating and sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT message.
The REJECT message contains the 5GSM cause IE to indicate the rejection reason.
The COMMAND message may contain the Authorized QoS rules IE.
The COMMAND message may contain the Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE.
The procedure includes stopping timer T3581 if PTI matches UE-requested procedure.
Semantic error in QoS operation condition leads to 5GSM cause #83 in REJECT message.
Syntactical error in QoS operation condition leads to 5GSM cause #84 in REJECT message.
Semantic error in packet filter condition leads to 5GSM cause #44 in REJECT message.
Syntactical error in packet filter condition leads to 5GSM cause #45 in REJECT message.
Receipt of REJECT message triggers SMF to stop timer T3591.
Receipt of REJECT message causes SMF to transition from PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING to PDU SESSION ACTIVE state.
Stopping T3591 occurs when SMF is in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state.
